name: Largest Strongly Shattered Set / Minimum Degree
details: The proposed pointwise bound $\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal H)\geq d_{\min}(\mathcal H)$ is false, even for finite binary classes.
proof: For $\mathcal P_n=2^{[n]}\setminus\{\emptyset,[n]\}$ with $n\geq3$, every $(n-1)$-face contains a deleted antipode, whereas an $(n-2)$-face fixing one coordinate to zero and one to one avoids both. Hence $\mathrm{ST}=n-2$. The punctured-cube 1-inclusion graph has minimum degree $n-1$.
witness_verification: For every $n\geq3$, the established values are $\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal P_n)=n-2<n-1=d_{\min}(\mathcal P_n)$.
